description: This Java class configures web security for a Spring Boot application. It extends WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter to define authentication and authorization settings, including custom user details service, password encoding, authorities mapping, and HTTP security rules.

classes.name: ApplicationSecurityConfiguration
classes.description: Spring Security configuration class for the application, setting up authentication providers, authorities mapper, and HTTP security rules.

methods.name: authenticationProvider
methods.description: Defines a DAO-based authentication provider using a custom user details service and bcrypt password encoder.

methods.name: authoritiesMapper
methods.description: Creates and configures a SimpleAuthorityMapper that converts authorities to uppercase and sets a default authority.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures AuthenticationManagerBuilder with the custom authentication provider.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures HttpSecurity to disable CSRF, frame options, set authorization rules, login page, logout behavior, and permitted URLs.
